speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: CMV Retinitis

The fundoscopic finding of granular yellow-white opacities with dot-blot hemorrhages ("pizza pie" appearance), combined with a critically low CD4 count of 36/mm³ and Kaposi's sarcoma history, strongly confirms Cytomegalovirus retinitis.
